subject: VEA_Icons

verdicts.notes: Rusty dented scrap, mismatched fasteners, copper twists and frayed tape clearly convey Scrapper. The scrap plaque remains recognisable at 32 px; transparent surroundings are clean.
Angular charcoal steel, heavy chamfers, bolts and restrained hazard stripes clearly convey Industrial. Bold panel silhouette survives at 32 px; no visible backdrop or halo.
An ordinary contemporary wall outlet clearly conveys Modern through familiar hardware and materials, satisfying B6. Recognisable at 32 px, with clean transparent surroundings.
Rounded silver-white housing, graphite recesses and a thin cyan strip clearly convey Futuristic. The main shapes and cyan accent remain distinct at 32 px; transparency appears clean.
Two insulators joined by a wire and a prominent green plus communicate adding a span. Hardware remains recognisable at 32 px; no visible backdrop, halo or drawn black keyline.
Red-handled cutters acting on a single wire span communicate removing one connection. The cutters and span remain recognisable at 32 px; transparent surroundings are clean.
A pole with several disconnected wire ends and a prominent prohibition badge communicates removing all spans. Distinct from the single-span cutter icon at 32 px; no visible alpha flaw.
